decision: Selected the site location that the Environment Agency's installations register publishes for permit EPR/MP3822ST (holder Equinix (UK) Limited, premises 'Equinix MA3, Joule House', 76 Trafford Wharf Road, Trafford Park, Manchester M17 1HE): latitude 53.468015, longitude -2.293397 (grid reference SJ8062096850), copied without transformation, as the project locator of Equinix MA3. It is the regulator's single site point for the permitted medium combustion plant at Joule House, not a building outline or surveyed position.

selected_properties.address: Equinix MA3, Joule House, Equinix MA3, 76 Trafford Wharf Road, Trafford Park, Manchester, M17 1HE

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published latitude and longitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:27700 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's easting and northing (380620, 396850) gives 53.4680273, -2.2934042, 1.45 m from the published point.

consistency_checks.permit_document: The register record links no GOV.UK permit publication, and GOV.UK search (local_data/country-research-uk-ops-p10/govuk-search-MP3822ST.json) returns none, so no second regulator grid reference is available.
consistency_checks.operator_address: Equinix's MA3 page (Internet Archive raw copy of 3 October 2026, local_data/country-research-uk-ops-p10/ia-eqx-ma3-20261003181018-r2.html) gives the address 'Joule House, 76 Trafford Wharf Road, M17 1HE Manchester' and 28,664 sq ft, matching the register's premises, street number and postcode. The same page's meta description, and the related-IBX blurbs on Equinix's other Manchester pages, instead say MA3 is 'located at Reynolds House Manchester, Technopark4 Archway', the wording also used for MA4; the address block and the independent government register agree on Joule House, so the blurb is treated as stale text.
consistency_checks.nearby_records: No Atlas record and no pending queue addition lies within 3 km. Environment Agency installations within 2 km include no other data-centre operator's permit; the only telecoms-type installation is Virgin Media Limited, 400 Metroplex, Broadway, Salford M50 2UE (EPR/XB3299YG, 1.18 km; a network operator's site, not in the Atlas). The nearest data-centre installation, Pulsant's Cobra Court, Trafford Park (EPR/NP3422SS), is about 2.19 km west-south-west; it is a uk-regions-p2 lead, not an Atlas record.
consistency_checks.not_used: No commercial map, map widget, map-link coordinate, geocoder, postcode centroid, PeeringDB, OpenStreetMap, town centre or estate centroid is used. The coordinate constants in the map-widget script of Equinix's archived pages were not read for the locator.

scope_note: The point locates Equinix's MA3 installation at Joule House.
